title: RPHA 71 Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Designed for high-mileage highway touring and demanding daily commutes, the HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black is engineered to isolate riders from harsh highway buffeting over 800km days. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1474g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~84 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Premium sport-touring model with advanced shock resistance.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for touring with extended cheek pads and a slightly larger internal volume; fits most head shapes but may feel loose on very small heads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Touring lineup, the RPHA 71 Matte Black brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~84 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Touring helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 71 Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
